svg.title: One flick to one target, made five ways, against a fixed beat. A fast flick with a fast correction lands early and waits. A fast flick with a slow correction overshoots and spends the rest of the time crawling back. A balanced hand takes one motion and a short correction. A slow flick falls short and snaps on at the end. A slow flick with a slow correction is still correcting when the beat arrives. The clock under each lane shows where that hand spent its time.

text.tspan: no time to fix the overshoot
cut off short by the tick
